description: Reports the essential operating state of an OCI IoT gateway.

contents.name: connectedDeviceCount
contents.description: Reports the number of indirectly connected devices currently communicating through the gateway.

contents.name: cpuUtilization
contents.description: Reports the percentage of gateway CPU capacity currently in use.

contents.name: memoryUtilization
contents.description: Reports the percentage of gateway memory currently in use.

contents.name: firmwareVersion
contents.description: Reports the firmware version running on the gateway.
